answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the timber check immediately, the tide audit keeps the resolved set and the zephyr replay publishes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 59 aliases therefore forfeits the reading cost 59 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
